Intake note (Property team, 22 December 2024). Our client Deepa Shinde is a 63-year-old restaurant owner who lives at Plot 84, Kowdiar, Thiruvananthapuram 695039 and can be reached on +91 61682 87381 or deepa.shinde@example.in. The client's PAN KASPS7554P.
